display.title: Parshas Zachor: A Once-a-Year Mitzvah
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi reminds everyone, young and old, to be in shul this Shabbos to hear Parshas Zachor and remember what Amalek did.
display.summary_long: A short reminder from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi calls Parshas Zachor an opportunity that comes only once a year: a mitzvah from the Torah itself to hear the special portion read in shul on the Shabbos before Purim. It tells us to remember what the wicked Amalek did to the Jewish people as they left Mitzrayim, and to erase every trace of Amalek. Every child and adult should be in shul to hear each word, and should encourage relatives and friends to come too. In the merit of this mitzvah, he prays, Hashem will let us see the final end of the Amaleks of today and send Moshiach.
display.lesson: Be in shul to hear Parshas Zachor, and bring your family and friends along.
